All fixtures are original solid red (RGB 230, 40, 20), 12 × 8 pixel test images generated for this repository using Pillow 13.0.0 and pillow-heif 1.8.1. They contain no third-party artwork. The second GIF frame and TIFF page are blue (RGB 10, 30, 230). `oriented.jpeg` and `oriented.heic` have EXIF orientation 6. The SVG is an original red rectangle. These tiny files deliberately exercise real codecs; no codec or normalization results are mocked.
